title: Using Cache for Docker Hardened Images (dhi.io) is not working anymore.
diagnostic_value: Separate upstream login-server or credential-set failure from ACR repository authorization.

title: Artifact cache rule for dhi.io multi-arch images intermittently fails with 424 Failed Dependency
diagnostic_value: Compare tag and child-digest resolution and preserve upstream and ACR correlation evidence.

title: ACR cache rule for ghcr.io returned 403 responses to the Referrers API
diagnostic_value: Test OCI referrer handling independently from ordinary manifest pulls.

title: Add registry/repository-level write-once tag immutability
diagnostic_value: Verify server-side policy versus pipeline-side locking before attributing an overwrite or denial.

title: Support Autoscaling/consumption based ACR Tasks for Internal ACR's
diagnostic_value: Include dedicated agent-pool capacity and subnet constraints in private task investigations.

title: ACR Networking - Add ACR Firewall Rule Support for Service Tags
diagnostic_value: Do not assume a service tag can be entered where registry rules require IP ranges.

title: Manage digest-only images same way as images with tags.
diagnostic_value: Use data-plane manifest inventory before concluding a digest-pulled artifact is absent.

title: Diagnostic logs for task runs
diagnostic_value: State telemetry gaps explicitly and obtain task-run records rather than inferring success from absent logs.

title: ACR Auth - ABAC-Enabled Registries as Default with Breaking Change Migration for Existing Non-ABAC (RBAC-Only) Registries
diagnostic_value: Inspect permission mode before interpreting role assignments; control-plane and repository data-plane rights differ.

title: ACR Inventory - Query Registry Image Inventory via Azure Resource Graph (ARG)
diagnostic_value: Do not assume Resource Graph exposes current repository, tag, or manifest inventory unless verified.

title: ACR High Availability - Bounded Staleness Consistency for Pushed Images in ACR Geo-Replication (Geo Sync Proxy)
diagnostic_value: Correlate push region, resolving replica, digest, and timestamps before proposing geo-sync delay.

title: Customer Metrics for Transactions and Data Transfer on Azure Monitor
diagnostic_value: Distinguish unsupported metric expectations from missing diagnostic configuration.

title: [ACR] Failing to pull docker images cached from an external repository
diagnostic_value: Test direct upstream availability, cache-rule match, credentials, and cached manifest separately.

title: [ACR][Azure CLI] Improve error/timeout reporting for az acr repository list / catalog enumeration when registry contains extremely high-tag repository (silent partial results)
diagnostic_value: Verify pagination and independent counts before accepting a large-registry CLI listing as complete.

title: Helm Upgrade/Install Fails with ImagePullBackOff for ACR Image in Azure DevOps Pipeline
diagnostic_value: Preserve all concurrent pull errors; authorization, empty reference, and platform mismatch require separate proof.

title: Workload identity based image pull from Azure Container Registry with Microsoft Entra authentication
diagnostic_value: Identify whether kubelet, workload, or another principal performs the pull before checking permissions.

title: [Feature] Workload Identity for ACR Image Pulls
diagnostic_value: Do not assume pod workload identity is the image-pull identity; determine the supported mechanism in the live cluster.

title: [BUG] Cannot pull ALB controller from other Container Registry, because /public is added to path
diagnostic_value: Compare declared and runtime-resolved repository paths before investigating ACR authorization.
